item.title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Sweeps The 2026 Annie Awards, Winning All 10 Awards For Which It Was Nominated
item.description: Here's our full rundown of the 53rd Annie Awards, including all the winners and the glamorous evening's most memorable presenters and moments.

item.title: Re:Anima Joint Master In Animation Has Opened A New Call For Applications
item.description: The program offers an intensive two-year exploration of animation from an artistic perspective in Ireland, Belgium, or Portugal.

item.title: New ‘Evangelion’ Series Announced With ‘NieR’ Creator Yoko Taro Writing
item.description: Studio Khara is teaming with CloverWorks (Spy x Family) to produce the new series, announced at the franchise's 30th anniversary celebration.

item.title: Animated ‘Venom’ Feature In The Works At Sony
item.description: Sony will put Marvel’s long-running anti-hero into a feature animation lead role for the first time with Zach Lipovsky and Adam B. Stein directing.

item.title: ‘GOAT’ Dunks On The Competition At The Weekend Box Office
item.description: 'GOAT' scored $17 million in its second weekend, hitting $58M domestic and $102M worldwide, a strong showing for an original animated release.

item.title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ To Get Physical Media Release Via The Criterion Collection
item.description: Criterion’s release reinforces the film's cultural impact and marks a huge moment for physical media fans often left longing for their streaming favorites.

item.title: ‘Zootopia 2,’ ‘Two Black Boys In Paradise’ Take Top BAFTA Animation Prizes
item.description: The event’s failure to edit out a shouted racial slur stood in stark contrast to a touching film about Black love and self-acceptance winning a top prize.

item.title: ‘Kiki’s Delivery Service’ Flies Back To Theaters, This Time in IMAX
item.description: More than three decades after its initial release, 'Kiki' is getting a 4K remaster for the big, really big, screen. U.S. and Canada tickets are on sale now.

item.title: ‘Pure, Unadulterated Rage And Grief,’ USC Students, Staff In Shock As University Shuts Down Its Expanded Animation Program
item.description: The decision includes layoffs of non-tenured faculty, with enrolled students reassigned to other divisions within USC’s School of Cinematic Arts.

item.title: From ‘Astartes’ To ‘Huxley’: Ben Mauro And Digital Bones On Creating The Animated Trailer For ‘The Oracle’
item.description: By exercising restraint and emphasizing atmosphere and visual storytelling, the short introduces a grounded war chapter in an expanding sci-fi mythology.
